summary: Visual QA of the light CRED-style redesign (Expo web, 390x844 and 320x700). I did one real PIN login (7004186276) and reused that session by injecting localStorage. Every non-GET /api/jl/** request was aborted, so no academic writes were made (no attempts, answers, submits, reflections, reports or PIN changes). Overall PASS: no red screen, tsc --noEmit is clean, and no purple was found by a computed-colour sweep of 14 screens. Entry: white canvas, JeeCircle.ai logo, black 'Sign in' segment and button. Home: 22 of 22 testIDs navigate correctly (account, series view-all/CTA/hub, 4 rail tiles, For You x3 open My Tests on the right tab, RF entry, promo CTA, My Tests view-all, 7 explore chips; share is a no-op on web). The All India card is black with a red CTA. The '18 DONE' badge renders. There is no Continue card because the in-progress count is 0. The tab bar is black (rgb 11,11,13) on all 5 tabs with a raised orb. The Rapid Fire tab and /rapid/leaderboard|shop|history stay fully dark (0 of 126 white samples each) and Home returns to light after visiting them. ExamHub for jee-main, bitsat and comedk is light with line-icon heroes; the destination rows navigate. My Tests: segment switch, BITSAT filter, search ('Work' gives 1 card), Open result -> /result/<id>, Saved empty state -> Explore exams. Result: the score card is a red-to-black gradient. Solutions: the question image is readable on white, 5 filters, the grid sheet opens and closes, and the report sheet opens and closes without submitting. /live hub: pastel cards are readable, 20 day chips load (no skeleton bug), the How it works sheet opens. /pyq, chapters, history, set detail (Start not tapped), account, change-pin (view only), forgot-pin, privacy, delete-account and performance all render light with no dark leftovers apart from intentional black CTAs. Issues are mostly minor layout and contrast items, listed below. Clipping at 320px: the promo banner copy is cut off.

ui_bugs.issue: At 320px the body text is clipped to 'score 200+ with AI. / 62 daily …' (text height 69 vs scrollHeight 92) and the 'AI ASTRA · 100% AI' eyebrow wraps to 2 lines. The 50px '200+' takes too much width. Reference: src/components/home/HomeParts.tsx:72-78 (numberOfLines=3, promoNum size 50). Fix: shrink or hide the number below ~360px, or stack it.

At 320px it truncates to '1 Dec – 31 Jan · one mock a d…'. Reference: src/components/series/HomeSeriesCard.tsx:64 (numberOfLines=1). Use a shorter narrow copy (e.g. 'one a day') like the existing 'ALL INDIA' narrow label.
At 320px the eyebrow truncates to 'JEE MAIN · CHAPTER P…' (app/set/[id].tsx header).
When focused, the browser's default black rectangular focus outline is drawn inside the rounded search pill. Add outlineStyle:'none' (web) to the TextInput.

issues: /pyq hero second line 'your next attempt.' is #A6A6AE on white = 2.42:1 at 26px (below 3:1 for large text). Use custom_eyebrow #8E8E97 or darker.
Home footer 'made for every aspirant.' is custom_qFreshLine #D9D9DF on white ≈1.4:1 (HomeParts.tsx:97). Fine if it is meant as a watermark, but it is real text with no accessibility hiding.
/live stats: the '0 skipped' icon is rgb(236,214,220) on rgb(251,239,241) = 1.23:1, almost invisible. The locked milestone icons are #A6A6AE on #F6F6F8 = 2.24:1.
home-promo-cta 'Know more' is 93x36 (<44pt). Reference: HomeParts.tsx:121 height 36.
Tab labels are 9.5px, the For You badges ('18 DONE', 'DUEL') are 8.5px and the rail badges are 9.5px. All are below ~11pt legibility. At 320px the gap between 'RAPID FIRE' and 'MY TESTS' is only 6px.
Chapter-wise (/catalogue chapters): the selected subject chip is filled RED (Physics) with red number rings, but everywhere else selection is black.
Solutions: the subject chip is a saturated mustard fill, the only loud colour block on the page.
Results & history: the negative score '-2 / 300' shows in success green, and 'Preparing result' is red (reads as an error) while My Tests shows the same state in orange.
My Tests chip row: a status chip (black) and the exam chip 'All exams' (dark grey) are both selected in the same scroll row, which reads as two different selection styles.
Catalogue: the '29 LIVE CHAPTER TESTS' label is only ~4px below the subject chips (needs 8-12px).
app.json splash and android adaptiveIcon backgroundColor are still #08080A (dark), so the app flashes dark before the white home on native launch.

react_native_issues.issue: When usesNativeTabs (iOS>=26), the app uses system liquid-glass tabs with tintColor colors.onSurface (#0F0F12), not the black CRED dock. On the dark Rapid Fire tab, near-black tint may be low-contrast. Cannot be verified on web. Reference: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:58-66

action_items: Fix the PromoBanner clipping at narrow widths (HomeParts.tsx:72-78): scale or hide '200+' below 360px, or allow 4 lines.
Add short narrow copy for the HomeSeriesCard date line (HomeSeriesCard.tsx:64) and the set-detail eyebrow at 320px.
Raise contrast: the /pyq hero 2nd line (#A6A6AE), the /live 'skipped' icon (1.23:1) and the locked milestone icons. Optionally darken the home footer watermark or hide it from accessibility.
Make home-promo-cta at least 44pt tall. Consider tab labels at least 10.5-11px and badges at least 9.5px.

Unify selection colour: make the chapter-wise subject chip and the solutions subject chip black or ink like the rest. Colour negative history scores in error or neutral, not green, and make 'Preparing result' amber consistently.
Add outlineStyle:'none' on web for the My Tests search TextInput.
Optional: update the app.json splash and adaptiveIcon backgroundColor to white to match the light theme. Check the iOS 26 NativeTabs tint on the dark RF tab.

Player (code review only, no in-progress attempt exists): contrast is OK (white numbers on green/red/teal bubbles, 'Save & Next' black with #F6F6F8 text). However, the selected option uses brand RED border, letter bubble and check (attempt/[id].tsx:330-333). In an exam this can read as 'wrong'; consider ink/black selection like the CRED style.
critical_code_review_comments: tsc --noEmit is clean. No references remain to the deleted ExamTile, ExamCardFinish, WebsiteGradient or tile images.
src/rapid/* imports rapidColors, and the shared ErrorBox/Stat use useTheme() (palette-aware), so there is no light leak in RF.
Glyph falls back to MDI for unknown names, which keeps a mixed icon style wherever the MDI fallback renders (e.g. /live stat icons and the solutions grid). Acceptable.
Set detail footer copy 'Owner-supplied TEJAS200 JEE Main chapter questions…' shows internal source naming to learners (possibly pre-existing).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all navigation and flows pass; 1 medium + several low visual issues)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only. One PIN login; all non-GET /api/jl/** aborted (the solution-open POST abort shows 'Couldn't record that you viewed this solution', which is a test artifact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Log in once via entry-phone-input / entry-pin-input / entry-continue-button. Save localStorage (jl_sid, jl_user) and inject it with add_init_script. Abort non-GET /api/jl/**. Note: aborting /auth/refresh on the entry screen shows a 'Couldn't check your session' notice, which is a test artifact. Use locator.click() for my-tests-tab-label-*. Result IDs: 952adf58-7270-4e2a-add7-25ab00733152 (Coordination Compounds), 876bd703-0de4-4444-a5a5-782a3fdb7a08 (Work Energy Power). Set /set/7673f038-c872-5dcd-95b3-249e1da78377. In-progress count is 0, so no player or Continue card. Use the contrast helper /tmp/contrast.js through page.evaluate.
